environment.qualification: WSL2 fixture performance evidence; not native Windows, macOS, or non-WSL Linux qualification

cached_content.method: five serial isolated starts after one warm-up; fresh browser, SQLite state, vault, and loopback service per start

ordinary_refresh.method: real authenticated loopback service and production browser client; deterministic fake Codex; click through refresh response, analytics reload, two animation frames, and re-enabled Refresh control

warm_managed_launch.method: warm loopback service and CLI entry through persisted successful fake-process-start reporting

idle_enrolled_service.method: real SQLite store, unlocked memory vault, enrolled scheduler, operational workflows, and authenticated HTTP API with no profiles; 100 ms settle then /proc samples across 2.001 seconds

bounded_sqlite_writes.method: 601-reading retention fixture spanning thirteen months and restart boundaries

responsive_thirteen_month_history.method: keyboard navigation through real authenticated service response, native SVG paths, 14-row semantic table, and two animation frames

limitations: Deterministic fake Codex replaces live provider collection.
Shared WSL2 resources are recorded and are not a universal performance promise.
Native interactive performance and lifecycle qualification remain separate.
